Application Data.NAME: Cozy Inn
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cozy Inn is a charming bed and breakfast offering comfortable accommodations with a maximum of 8 guest rooms. We provide complimentary continental breakfast each morning, featuring pastries, fruits, and beverages, adhering to strict food safety protocols. Our facility is a two-story building with exterior corridors, ensuring accessibility while minimizing fire risks. We maintain well-documented safety procedures and have up-to-date fire protection systems in place. Our operations are open year-round, catering to both leisure and business travelers seeking a welcoming atmosphere in Springfield, IL. We do not have on-site bar or lounge facilities, thereby reducing potential liquor liability exposures.
